notes.notes: [p]1、The True Immortal Event Begins: When the in-game time reaches 10,000 years, the "Heavenly Supervising True Immortal" descends upon Tianyuan City, initiating the Harvest Cycle. [/p][p]2、Nine Duels: True Immortals can be defeated nine times. Each time they are reborn, they become stronger. New pre-battle and post-battle dialogue and choice rewards have been added.
